affected_system: housing-stability, eviction prevention, shelter diversion, and support coordination
alternatives: activate a bounded reserve from forecast risk bands for housing-stability and homelessness-prevention demand
use rolling forecasts and conservative capacity triggers for housing-stability and homelessness-prevention demand
pair market, court, season, and service-flow forecasting with an explicit stop, review, and escalation rule
assumptions: Court, assistance, shelter, outreach, housing, and service records use privacy-preserving linkage.
Risk models support outreach only and never determine legal rights or automatic denial.
All alternatives, capacities, costs, effects, thresholds, and failure scenarios are proposed until bound to evidence.
baseline: continue ordinary capacity planning for housing-stability and homelessness-prevention demand.

constraints.description: The homelessness prevention and housing stability forecast must respect declared validated operational capacity and forecast uncertainty.
Every released metric must retain evidence type, source lineage, geography, time, assumptions, and uncertainty.
No analytical output may bypass lawful authority, accountable human review, or an applicable appeal process.

decision_cadence: recompiled at each planning cycle and after material evidence change
decision_owner: homelessness response director and housing-stability administrator
decision_question: What range of legal, rental, diversion, outreach, and shelter demand should the system prepare for?

independence_key.binding_constraint: The homelessness prevention and housing stability forecast must respect declared validated operational capacity and forecast uncertainty.
independence_key.evidence_gate: Evidence for housing-stability and homelessness-prevention demand passes documented checks for held-out error, interval coverage, event detection, drift, and baseline comparison.
independence_key.intervention_mechanism: market, court, season, and service-flow forecasting
independence_key.primary_outcome: priority household demand above prevention capacity

intended_claim: A versioned forecast design for comparing declared alternatives affecting housing-stability and homelessness-prevention demand, conditional on its evidence gate.
limitations: This library record has no city binding and therefore reports no local input, output, or recommendation.
Readiness describes explicit source and method gates; it does not certify implementation feasibility.
External domain, legal, community, security, and operational review remains outside this design artifact.

objectives.metric: priority household demand above prevention capacity
distributional gap in priority household demand above prevention capacity
decision claims with complete evidence lineage

prohibited_claims: Do not call forecast service demand evictions, homelessness entries, or individual risk.
Do not describe a design-only record as a city execution, deployment, adopted policy, or impact result.
Do not relabel proposed, estimated, simulated, optimized, or causal evidence as observed evidence.
Do not infer individual behavior, protected status, harm, or entitlement from aggregate records.

release_gate.failure_release: Release an explicit insufficient-evidence record naming missing sources, failed diagnostics, prohibited claims, and the next validation action.
release_gate.pass_condition: Evidence for housing-stability and homelessness-prevention demand passes documented checks for held-out error, interval coverage, event detection, drift, and baseline comparison.

title: Forecast housing-stability service demand
transportability_risks: Eviction law, rents, benefits, shelter systems, informal displacement, and data linkage differ.
Administrative records omit people who do not seek or cannot access services.
